title: QuantFace: Towards Lightweight Face Recognition by Synthetic Data Low-bit Quantization
reasoning: The paper discusses privacy concerns and legal privacy issues related to face recognition and proposes a privacy-friendly methodology (synthetic data, quantization) to address these. While privacy is an ethical consideration, the paper's focus is on presenting a technical solution to mitigate these issues, rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical components of AI models or societal implications of ethics/morals/faith.
